method: Uniform SRTM hypsometric tint + modern 2022 IGBP land cover + ASTER shaded relief, fixed cross-tile normalisation; numeric elevations use GLO90 profiles. Ten 2048-pixel / 2-degree focus tiles refine major rivers, passes, snow mountains, grassland and reunion regions.
interpretation: Modern physical geography; white high-altitude tint does not reconstruct historical snow cover.
